records.identityKey: businessId + policyId + subject + period + asOf + visibilityScopeHash

metrics.label: Open work / WIP
metrics.formula: distinct open WorkItems at asOf; in-progress + blocked

metrics.label: Planned load
metrics.formula: confirmed known planned minutes / available minutes

metrics.label: Capacity gap
metrics.formula: overbooked minutes + unscheduled/unassigned demand + required/capacity FTE

metrics.label: Accepted throughput
metrics.formula: distinct items with final accepted evidence in period

metrics.label: On-time commitments
metrics.formula: accepted by frozen dueAt / items committed as due

metrics.label: First-pass acceptance
metrics.formula: items accepted on first formal review / items with first completed review

metrics.label: Reopen rate
metrics.formula: accepted items reopened in window / accepted items with observed window

metrics.label: Cycle time p50/p85
metrics.formula: nearest-rank elapsed minutes from first IN_PROGRESS to final ACCEPTED

metrics.label: Effort variance
metrics.formula: (reviewed actual minutes - frozen estimate minutes) / frozen estimate minutes

metrics.label: Outcome attainment
metrics.formula: approved execution-mode progress strategy against target version

metrics.label: Blocked time
metrics.formula: union blocked intervals / eligible elapsed working minutes

metrics.label: Data coverage
metrics.formula: eligible records with required data / eligible records

design.CANDIDATE: Documented proposal; owner/API/adapter approval or proof may still be required
design.APPROVED_DESIGN_BASELINE: Owner-approved immutable contract baseline; implementation is not implied
design.REGISTERED: Canonical FR/FEAT/ADR/SDD/SEC/NFR subject allocated through the repository ledger
design.IMPLEMENTATION_READY: Affected SPEC gates, owner ports, schemas, migration and acceptance fixtures are closed for the slice
design.IN_IMPLEMENTATION: Code or migration work is active against the pinned packet
design.LOCALLY_VERIFIED: Relevant tests/build/browser checks pass in the named local environment
design.HOSTED_VERIFIED: Hosted CI or artifact verification passed for the named revision
design.PRODUCTION_ACTIVE: Production activation evidence exists for the exact revision
design.PROPOSED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Contract file exists; no running handler or live endpoint is claimed

data.COMPLETE: Required source and coverage are present for the authorized calculation
data.PARTIAL: Some eligible source or permission coverage is missing; result is shown with exclusions
data.UNKNOWN: A required fact is unavailable; do not substitute zero or infer completion
data.UNAVAILABLE: Source or contract is not available to this surface
data.PROVISIONAL: Window/cohort is still open and may change
data.INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE: Policy minimum sample is not met
data.STALE: Source version or projection freshness is outside policy
data.FORBIDDEN: Authorization denies the scope; suppress identifiers and counts

delivery.PLANNED: Scheduled for a future phase; no work evidence
delivery.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed because a named dependency or gate is open
delivery.NOT_REPORTED: Expected measurement is absent; never fallback to predicted value
delivery.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a later approved subject while preserving the old key
delivery.REJECTED: Review or validation refused the packet

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: A=4 tasks/35h and B=8 tasks/18h with available 28h/30h
acceptanceCriteria.required: A=125%, B=60%, team=91.38%; show A +7h overload

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Estimate, calendar or assignment is missing
acceptanceCriteria.required: Count remains visible; UNKNOWN/PARTIAL and exclusions visible; no invented free hours/FTE/zero performance

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Completed nondeleted WorkItem is in old activeWorkItems
acceptanceCriteria.required: New open count excludes accepted/cancelled through versioned status mapping; compatibility field preserved

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Person belongs to two teams or work links two features
acceptanceCriteria.required: Business totals deduplicate people/work/allocations; team shares required for additive capacity

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Holiday/leave overlaps or crosses timezone/DST boundary
acceptanceCriteria.required: Interval union subtracts once; half-open/DST rules hold; no negative capacity

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Two previews book the same person capacity
acceptanceCriteria.required: At most allowed capacity commits unless authorized reasoned override; stale conflict is visible

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Project-only viewer asks for Business performance or hidden evidence
acceptanceCriteria.required: Denied/suppressed without identifier/count leakage; no global-free claim
Original on-time denominator remains; adjusted baseline is separate

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Task is reassigned or Employment ends
acceptanceCriteria.required: Historical attribution stays pinned; active capacity changes prospectively; no access mutation

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Actual log absent, estimate zero or no formal review
acceptanceCriteria.required: Metric is null with reason; updatedAt is never substituted

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Reopen or late/duplicate delivery event occurs
acceptanceCriteria.required: Mature/provisional cohort is correct; event counted once; revision auditable

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Team has differently sized metric denominators
acceptanceCriteria.required: Team percentage pools counts and percentiles recalculate from samples
Table/agenda keyboard path equals drag preview/conflict behavior at 200% zoom

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Sample too small or work types are incomparable
acceptanceCriteria.required: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE or separate cohorts; no spurious rank/score
Same key/payload returns same receipt; changed payload is refused

acceptanceCriteria.givenWhen: Allocation references agent/unresolved assignee or foreign Business
acceptanceCriteria.required: Separate queue or refusal; no phantom employee capacity/cross-scope mutation

entryGates: Root registers canonical requirement/capability/architecture subjects through docs/.id-ledger.json; no proposal-local ID is used in @req annotations
G14 graph is reconciled as an extension of PM-G01, with one graph authority and no duplicate runtime topology
workforce.openapi.candidate.yaml version and operation/schema refs are pinned in the approved packet
SPEC-G01 through SPEC-G08 are closed only for the affected phase; SPEC-G09 registration/baseline proof is recorded
Identity capability binding and cross-domain owner-port decisions are approved before mutation code
SPEC-G07 physical adapter, transaction, RLS/grant, backfill and rollback design is approved before schema/migration work

integration: future external calendar/time adapters only; no second WorkItem writer
taskUsageLedger: separate implementation telemetry evidence; task-bound actual usage only when a direct taskCode/report binding exists; never grants G14 authority or marks a runtime feature ready

noGo: Do not create a route button or production endpoint while the screen status is CANDIDATE/PROPOSED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
Do not treat Team membership, Employment title, agent inventory or graph edge as a permission grant
Do not convert story points to hours or missing actual work/token/time to zero/predicted values
Do not infer acceptance from WorkItem.updatedAt, comments, worker exit code or status text without DeliveryEvent/evidence
Do not create a new database table or migration from this candidate registry alone
Do not register a new canonical ID by guessing the next number or reuse FR-042/FR-036/FR-064/FR-086/FR-193

constraints.time: Integer minutes internally; display hours only; IANA timezone and explicit DST handling
constraints.privacy: Individual performance and evidence are separately authorized; unauthorized identifiers, denominators and evidence links are suppressed
constraints.persistence: Every mutable record has UUID, scope, timestamps, version, soft-delete/history semantics as specified; AuditEvent is immutable
constraints.progress: Workforce capacity and delivery performance do not replace strategy-based Workstream progress
constraints.separation: G14 semantic graph is not the work Dependency DAG or Data Pipeline Map
constraints.evidence: Static docs, Swagger rendering and synthetic examples are not live API, migration, employee-data or production proof
